P1.established:
allow_cancel(age_seconds, until_start_seconds) -> bool
- age_seconds: int (seconds since reservation creation, >= 0)
- until_start_seconds: int (seconds remaining until start, 0 = start moment, < 0 = already started)
- Time conversion is handled by the caller.
P1.still_open: Logic for determining True/False based on P2-P5

P2.established:
Business hours: Mon-Fri
- General cancellation deadline: 24 hours before start
- After start: General cancellation is closed
- Exception: Correction time exists for recently booked customers

P3.established:
Staff accepts correction requests even after general deadline or start time
- Return True if cancellation allowed, False otherwise
- Use P2 and P5 as basis
P3.still_open: Logic for determining True/False based on P2-P5

H1.established: Correction time starts from reservation creation time
H1.still_open: Logic for determining True/False based on P2-P5

H3.still_open: Logic for determining True/False based on P2-P5

H4.still_open: Logic for determining True/False based on P2-P5
